## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library("tidyverse")
```

## Load data

We start from the wrangled files in `data/processed/`:

-   `laml_expression_joined.rds`: one row per gene per sample, with the
    expression on the log2(count + 1) scale (60,660 genes, 151 samples)
-   `laml_metadata_matched.rds`: one row per sample, for the same 151
    samples

```{r}
expr_long <- read_rds("../data/processed/laml_expression_joined.rds") |>
  select(Ensembl_ID,
         sample,
         log2_count = expression)

samples <- read_rds("../data/processed/laml_metadata_matched.rds") |>
  select(sample,
         patient = submitter_id,
         gender = gender.demographic,
         age = age_at_index.demographic)
```

All 151 samples are peripheral blood from the same tissue source site
(Washington University), so specimen type and site are not kept as
variables.

```{r}
samples |>
  count(gender)
```

## Check the scale of the values

If the values are log2(count + 1), then 2\^x - 1 should give whole
numbers.

```{r}
set.seed(42)

expr_long |>
  slice_sample(n = 10000) |>
  mutate(count = 2^log2_count - 1) |>
  summarise(frac_whole_numbers = mean(abs(count - round(count)) < 1e-6))
```

## Normalise for library size

Samples are sequenced to different depths, so the raw counts are not
comparable between samples. We go back to raw counts, divide by the
total number of counts in each sample (counts per million, CPM) and take
log2(CPM + 1). The library size is computed on all genes, before the low
expression filter.

```{r}
expr_long <- expr_long |>
  mutate(count = round(2^log2_count - 1)) |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  mutate(cpm = count / sum(count) * 1e6) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(log2_expr = log2(cpm + 1)) |>
  select(Ensembl_ID, sample, log2_expr)
```

## Remove genes with low expression

Genes that are hardly expressed only add noise and make the per-gene
models slower. We keep genes with log2(CPM + 1) \> 1 in at least 20% of
the samples.

```{r}
genes_to_keep <- expr_long |>
  group_by(Ensembl_ID) |>
  summarise(frac_expressed = mean(log2_expr > 1)) |>
  filter(frac_expressed >= 0.2)

n_genes_before <- expr_long |>
  distinct(Ensembl_ID) |>
  nrow()
n_genes_after <- nrow(genes_to_keep)
```

`r format(n_genes_after, big.mark = ",")` of
`r format(n_genes_before, big.mark = ",")` genes are kept.

## One row per sample

The analyses need one row per sample and one column per gene, joined
with the sample information.

```{r}
dat_aug <- expr_long |>
  semi_join(genes_to_keep, by = "Ensembl_ID") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Ensembl_ID,
              values_from = log2_expr)

dat_aug <- samples |>
  inner_join(dat_aug, by = "sample")
```

Check that no samples were lost in the join (we expect 151 samples, 67
female and 84 male).

```{r}
samples |>
  anti_join(dat_aug, by = "sample") |>
  count(name = "n_samples_not_matched")

dat_aug |>
  count(gender)
```

## Save

```{r}
write_tsv(dat_aug, "../data/processed/03_dat_aug.tsv.gz")
```
